title: airgap: OCI-diff prefetch + multi-arch bootstrap for constrained registries
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds an OCI-diff prefetcher and multi-arch staged bootstrap to reduce air-gapped seed size and speed installer cold-starts. Includes preflight checks for registry feature compatibility and Terraform/Helm hooks for manifest seeding.
description:
Motivation: On constrained air-gapped sites customers frequently seed registries over slow links or with strict manifest size limits. Packing full images into a single bundle increases transfer time and memory during bootstrap. This change introduces a two-part approach: 1) OCI-diff prefetch manifests that describe layered deltas between runtime releases to apply incremental updates rather than full-image transfers, and 2) a multi-arch staged bootstrap (tiny rootfs + platform-specific runtime layers) that reduces initial bootstrap size for heterogeneous clusters.

What this PR does: Consolidates the vendor index generator, adds a delta manifest producer (oci-diff) and a prefetch CLI used by offline registry seeders, implements installer preflight checks to detect registry features (redirects, manifest-list support, chunked-uploads), and wires Helm/Terraform seeding hooks so the private-installer can optionally apply deltas in order. It also adds documentation and test harnesses for simulated slow-link integration tests.

Checklist: [x] delta manifest format (schema v1) added and documented; [x] vendor-index generator extended to emit delta targets; [x] prefetch CLI (airgap-prefetch) + invocation example added; [x] installer preflight feature detector added to preflight.sh; [x] helm chart hooks to call airgap-prefetch during chart install/upgrade included; [x] terraform module extension to accept delta-manifest inputs; [x] integration tests (slow-link, manifest-only, full-bundle fallback).

Commits summary: - Add oci-diff generator and delta schema (4 commits) - airgap-prefetch CLI + unit tests (3 commits) - vendor-index updates to reference delta manifests (2 commits) - preflight registry feature detector + docs (2 commits) - Helm hook scripts and Terraform variable plumbing (2 commits) - integration test harness and CI job (1 commit).

Files changed (high-level): - tooling/vendor-index/generator.go (emits delta targets) - tooling/oci-diff/ (generator, schema, tests) - tooling/airgap-prefetch/cmd/ (CLI, README) - installer/preflight/preflight.sh (registry capability detector) - charts/private-installer/templates/hooks/prefetch-job.yaml (Helm hook) - terraform/modules/registry-seed/variables.tf & main.tf (delta-manifest input) - tests/integration/slow-link/* (simulated seeder + verification) - docs/airgap/delta-manifests.md (format and migration notes)

Review thread (excerpt): Jordan Kim: "Nice approach; can we ensure the delta schema is backwards-compatible with existing vendor indexes? Also add more explicit verifier for checksum ordering to avoid partial-apply failures."
Maya (author): "Schema is opt-in; vendor-index emits both full and delta references. Added a deterministic checksum ordering test and a fail-safe fallback to full-bundle apply when delta apply fails (documented)."
Diego Ramos: "Preflight looks good but add a timeout and clearer logs when registry returns 401/403 to avoid installer blocking on auth misconfigurations."
Maya: "Added 30s default timeout, error codes surfaced in preflight output and documented recommended registry policies (no anonymous redirect)."
Priya Singh: "Helm hooks look fine; confirm chart upgrade path won't double-apply on retry."
Maya: "Helm hook is annotated with hook-weight and owner references; idempotency ensured by prefetch CLI using a marker file that is checked before execution."

CI summary: - unit: pass - integration(slow-link): pass (flaky around network sim, stabilized by 2 retries) - lint: pass - e2e on k3s: pass - airgap-seed smoke: pass. The slow-link integration job was added to pipeline and runs with a simulated 500ms RTT and 256kbps throughput profile.

Migration notes and operational guidance: - Existing customers using full-bundle seeding will be able to opt-in to delta manifests by enabling the new 'delta_manifests' flag in the registry-seed Terraform module. Default behavior remains full-bundle for compatibility. - The preflight detector will log registry capabilities; teams should ensure their on-prem OCI registry supports manifest lists and range-chunked uploads to take full advantage of deltas. - In case of delta-apply failure, the installer will fall back to full-image apply and emit a clear audit log entry to aid debugging.

Testing performed: - unit tests for oci-diff payload generation and checksum ordering (local) - CI integration that exercises prefetch against a local containerd registry with simulated packet loss - manual end-to-end seeding of a small cluster on vSphere to validate multi-arch staged bootstrapping (amd64 + arm64).

Backward compatibility and fallback behavior: delta manifests are additive and optional; vendor-index still references full-image bundles for older installer versions. Prefetch CLI and Helm hooks are guarded behind a feature-flag so teams can roll out gradually.

Merge: squash-and-merge after CI green and 2 approvals. Post-merge tasks: bump release notes, add an entry in upgrade.md describing the opt-in flag and recommended registry settings.

Outcome: merged via squash with commit message: "airgap(prefetch): add oci-diff prefetch and staged multiarch bootstrap (opt-in delta manifests)\n\nResolves: ENG-9012, OPS-3287; provides initial tooling for incremental seeding in constrained air-gapped sites."
